name: idle-repair-stand-walk
summary: kill Jennifer's borrowed standing idle driver midstream through ISacsProxy.ReleaseDriver, leaving its mapping and posture intact. The premise proves oldMapped>0 and oldValid=0 without repairing it. Baseline idleRepairStream after that kill, then sit, stand and walk to another seat under the motion watch. The stream must repair the dead driver and no client-only restart may follow its repair. Only the idle driver is released, so unrelated replay machines survive.
expect: known-failing: (2026-11-10), FC ruling: run 20261110-204629 is a real failure candidate. After a borrowed idle was proved dead (oldValid=0, oldMapped=1), the stream never repaired it: ownRepairs stayed 39, idleRepairStream stayed 10 and replay failures rose 7->11 (+4). Run 20261110-210312 only repaired through the premise itself and cannot close this finding. Re-run once after w1's BootstrapStandingIdle fix merges, requiring a stream repair after the kill and no client-only restart (internal documentation section 4.2).
